# Copilot Instructions — SchoolCollab

**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root first.** It is the
single point of entry for every AI coding agent working on this repo (the
[AGENTS.md open standard](https://agents.md), auto-read by the GitHub Copilot
coding agent, VS Code Copilot, Cline, pi, Cursor, Codex, and others). All
repository-wide rules live there once; nothing is duplicated here.

This file exists only because Copilot surfaces auto-load
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` by name. Keeping it a pointer prevents the
two files from drifting apart.

Quick pointers (full details and rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md)):

- Specialty rule files: `.github/copilot/rules/` (index: its `README.md`)
- Repo-local agent skills: `.github/skills/` and `.pi/skills/`
- Cline memory-graph conventions: `CLINE.md`
- Durable specs and research: `documents/specs/`, `documents/solution/`
- Ephemeral per-round agent docs: `documents/rounds/` (see its `README.md`)
